pages.text:
Carrot and Hazelnut are best friends.
Today is a very special day because
they are going to watch a big
football match together! "Yay! I love football!" says Carrot. "Me too! Me too!" says Hazelnut.

They find their seats, but they
are way in the back and can't
see the ball well. "Where's the ball?" says Hazelnut.
Someone scores, and everybody jumps up! "Goooaaal!" says Crowd. "Huh? Where?" says Carrot. "Aww! We didn't see!" says Hazelnut.
"I wanna see!" says Carrot. "Let's go down there!" says Hazelnut.

They wiggle through tall legs
and move down a few rows. "Excuse me! Excuse me!" says Hazelnut.
Now they have a good view. "Closer! Closer!" says Carrot. "But I see the ball!" says Hazelnut.

Since nobody stops them, they
keep sneaking closer and closer. "Shh! Sneaky, sneaky!" says Carrot.

They reach the very front row with
a great view, but Carrot keeps going. "Carrot, stop! It's good enough!" says Hazelnut.
Zoom, zoom, zoom! Carrot runs right past the front row, all the way onto the grass! "Wheee! So close!" says Carrot.
Uh-oh! Now they're right in the middle of the field! All the players stop and stare at them. "Ohhhhh!" says Crowd. "Oops!" says Carrot. "Too close!" says Hazelnut.

The referee walks them back to the front row. "The grass is for the players, little ones," says Referee. "Sorry!" says Carrot. "That's okay. Enjoy the game!" says Referee. "The best seat," says Hazelnut, "is next to you!"
